note: Official blank forms for the 'print and take to the office' flow (tahsil). Downloaded from the department's own S3WaaS file store; sha256 of the copy read on 19 Nov 2026. The PDFs go to the server branch local-forms in Step 3, not into the app.

online_route.what: The same ration card services (new card, add / remove name, address change, duplicate) are also online on RCMS Public Login — the department's Services page links every one of them there.
online_route.guide_note: Govt circular संकीर्ण-2023/प्र.क्र.107, 20 Dec 2023 + 21-page RCMS help module. Registration and login need an OTP on the mobile linked to Aadhaar (or user name + password + OTP, or ration card number + OTP).
online_route.app_rule: Show both: online (RCMS, needs the Aadhaar-linked mobile for OTP) or the paper form at the rationing / tahsil supply office. Paper is for the farmer whose mobile isn't linked or who goes to the office.
